asr.full_text: Hello everyone, I am Sahil Ingvarani and I would like to share my interview experience with IBM. First of all, I would like to thank PlacementBoat for giving me this opportunity to share my interview experience with you. IBM, that is International Business Machine Corporation is an American multinational technology and consulting firm it basically manufactures and markets computer hardware and software products it also offers infrastructure hosting and consulting in the products ranging from mainframe computers to nanotechnology. It was a 2 day process, the process started with the company's presentation. They told about the company and what profile are they offering us. They told about what we are going to work there and then we had written test the written test was of one hour and it basically comprised of two types of questions. one was of series questions, 20 questions on series like various types of sequences were given and you have to like write down the next number in it and the second type of question was on statements two types of two statements were given and you basically need to tell that if it can be answered using the question asked can be answered using above two statements the question asked can be answered using the above two statements after this test a shortlist was announced and the shortlisted students underwent another test on English the test was of 20 minutes and it was very simple test i completed it in within 10 minutes and after that also another shortlist was announced and after that um basically the process for the day was over and they did document verification of all the students. As the cutoff was 65%, they also refused many candidates whose percentage was not up to the mark. The next day we had an interview. My interview lasted for about 10 minutes. As such he didn't ask me any technical question. His main focus was since I belong to electronics and communication branch and IBM is an IT consulting firm, so his main focus was that if I am ready, if I am willing to join an IT consulting firm or not so I told him that I have done a lot of programming stuff my projects also include some programming so he was so far convinced convinced then he asked me about many other languages like Java HR questions that's it and interview process was done after the interviews like in the evening the final result was announced and I was one of the successful candidates I would like to give the viewers a couple of suggestions to crack IBM interview first of all actually they give preference to circuit branch so if you are from one of the circuit branch may be electronics electrical computer id then you are definitely given a preference. You definitely have an edge over others. But if you belong to a not circuital branch. Then I would suggest that you do some of the programming stuff. Maybe a couple of projects. You can take help from the circuital branches. circuitry branches guys and Another suggestion that I would like to give to all you all of you that maintain a decent percentage may be above 70 because they give a lot of preference to the candidates who have a high percentage and yeah the third and the Most important suggestion is be Confident during the interview that is the most important suggestion is be confident during the interview! That is the most important thing even if you are speaking something that is not truth, speak with confidence then like when I convinced him that I belong to electronics branch and I can work in a software company i also spoke something that was not truth so maybe you can like fake at that moment but with confidence so that's it um about the interview process and suggestions to all of you. Thanks a lot everyone for your patience. And if have any queries you can comment below and we will answer to the best of our knowledge as soon as possible. And you can also like and subscribe the channel this Channel Placement Board. Thanks a lot everyone
